description: Call after acting on a road, whatever happened, so the next agent knows. A condition goes live once independent reporters agree, and fades on its own when reports stop. Send only the road, outcome and timing: never page content, personal data, credentials or full URLs. Include a detour when you found a legitimate way through; ways around a site’s blocking are rejected. Needs a free key from lanerouter.com/connect.

action.description: Same short verb you checked with, e.g. checkout, login, search. Defaults to visit.

detour.description: A legitimate route you used or tried instead.

kind.description: official_api, alternate_endpoint (another endpoint the site offers), wait_and_retry, hand_to_human, or different_provider.

note.description: One short line on how it worked.

target.description: Where the detour goes, e.g. the official API host.

worked.description: true if the detour got the job done.

framework.description: Agent framework family, e.g. claude-code, cursor, langgraph. Shown to site owners in aggregate only.

http_status.description: HTTP status code you received, e.g. 200, 403, 429, 503.

latency_ms.description: How long the request or step took, in milliseconds.

outcome.description: clear: worked normally. slow: worked but much slower than usual. rate_limited: throttled (429). wall: blocked as an agent (403, CAPTCHA, "unauthorized agent" page). changed: response shape or page flow changed. broken: server errors for everyone.

target.description: URL or host/path you acted on. Reduced to the road before it is stored.

name: report_road
title: Report what happened
